release.content: pubkit 0.29.0 was released on 2026-11-05 from commit d52574bbf21362fa405d2463d721b9de84586a4c with these changes.

rows: pubkit signing-key backup writes the signing keys repositories declare in pubkit.json's new signing_keys block to their Bitwarden projects, each found by its id with its name as a label (a run warns when Bitwarden's name differs; a plain name matches in any case when only one project has it), with the SDK and a token typed at a hidden prompt: one repository, or every one under --under DIR. It skips a key already backed up, never overwrites a different value, points out an undeclared corpus key, and --dry-run asks for nothing. pubkit sync --check refuses a signing_keys block it can't use.

pubkit sync moves a Bitwarden use integrations.json declares on with-secrets to with-secrets.json in a service, as the one-line with-secrets pubkit 0.28.0 writes no longer calls bws and the integrations scan called that declaration stale; sync --check fails until it is moved.

pubkit signing-key backup finds a declared Bitwarden project by its id, given as {"id", "name"} with the name as a label (a run warns when Bitwarden's name differs), or by a name matched in any case when only one project has it; its output names each project with its id, then lists that project's keys under it, one per line
